右键新建节点 · 删除键移除 · Ctrl+拖拽连线 · Ctrl+滚轮缩放画布: Right-click to add node · Del to remove · Ctrl+drag to connect · Ctrl+scroll to zoom canvas · Scroll in preview to zoom · Alt+hover to split curve
将替换当前画布确定吗: will replace the current canvas. Continue?
about_subtitle: Data load → transform → visualize, all wired visually.
按列名或 1 起始索引提取表格列。: Extract table columns by name or 1-based index.
按某列数值区间筛选行(可剔除离群点)。: Filter rows by value range in a column (outliers excluded).
按行区间与步长提取表格子集。: Extract a table subset by row range and stride.
把散点转换为表格(列:x、y,含三维时为 x、y、z),便于输出、清洗或继续处理: Convert scatter to table (columns: x,y or x,y,z for 3D) for output, cleaning, or further processing.
差异分析火山图:以 log2FC 与 p 值两列绘制,自动标注显著点。: Differential volcano plot from log2FC and p-value columns, with significant points labeled.
定义 x-y 平面上的一个面图元(适配 2D 坐标系或 3D 坐标系的 x-y: Define a surface primitive on the x-y plane (works in 2D or the x-y plane of 3D): preset circle/ellipse/rectangle or custom polygon from point list. Configurable color, opacity, and edge.
定义一个可调节的渐变色带:增删渐变停止点、调整颜色与位置。输出\"色带\",接入: Define an editable gradient color band. Add/remove stops and adjust colors/positions. The output color band controls mappings in heatmaps and other charts.
定义一个文本图元:内容、文本大小(厘米)、在坐标轴盒内的位置、背景色/文字颜色与: Define a text primitive: content, size in cm, position in the axis box, background/text color and font. Rendered at cm scale via Procedural Output.
定义一个坐标系:维度(2D/3D)、各轴厘米长度、X/Y 起止数字、坐标轴定位方: Define a coordinate system: 2D/3D dimension, per-axis cm length, X/Y start-end numbers, axis positioning. Presets, per-axis color/thickness/grid toggle, text style and export pixel size. Tick count auto-selected by pixel density.
对表格抽样:取前 N 行、隔行抽样或随机抽样。: Sample a table: take first N rows, every-other, or random.
对曲线做数值求导(中心差分),输出导数曲线。: Numerical derivative of a curve (central differences).
对曲线做梯形法累积积分,输出积分曲线。: Trapezoidal cumulative integration of a curve.
对散点做多项式(1~3 阶)或指数拟合,输出拟合曲线与系数表。: Polynomial (1-3) or exponential fit to scatter. Outputs fitted curve and coefficient table.
对数值列做 min-max 归一化或 z-score 标准化。: Min-max normalization or z-score standardization of numeric columns.
多组数值分布箱线图:每个数值列一个箱体。: Box plot: one box per numeric column.
多组数值分布小提琴图(核密度估计):每个数值列一个小提琴。: Violin plot (KDE): one violin per numeric column.
关系网络图(力导向布局):按源列→目标列构建边。: Force-directed network graph from source→target columns.
将曲线数据转化为散点数据,并携带点形状/大小/颜色。点大小与点颜色可暴露为输入口: Convert curve data to scatter with shape/size/color. Size and color exposed as inputs — vary per point from data columns.
流程/流量桑基图:按源列→目标列聚合权重。两条色带分别映射输入轴(左侧条带)与输: Flow Sankey: aggregate weights from source→target columns. Two color bands map input (left) and output (right); connecting flows gradient from source to target color.
清理表格:缺失值填充(零/均值/线性插值)、删除含缺失的行、去除重复行。: Clean table: fill missing (zero/mean/linear), drop missing rows, dedupe.
输出节点:显示传入表格数据的预览(列名 + 前若干行),便于检查流水线中间结果。: Output node: preview incoming table (column names + first rows) for inspecting intermediate results.
输入表格数据:支持内置预设(火山图/销售/鸢尾花/物理曲线),或粘贴 CSV/T: Input table data: built-in presets (volcano/sales/iris/physics curves), paste CSV/TSV, or import from file.
输入函数表达式 y=f(x),输出按区间采样生成的曲线。支持 x、sin/cos: Input y=f(x) expression, output curve sampled over an interval. Supports x, sin/cos/tan/exp/log/sqrt/abs, ^, pi, e.
输入两条曲线,求折线段相交点,输出为散点(点组)。平行/共线段忽略,交点自动去重: Given two curves, find polyline-polyline intersections (output as scatter groups). Parallel/colinear segments ignored; duplicates removed.
输入一条曲线/折线:参数方程生成或手动输入点列。: Input a curve/polyline: generated from parametric equation or manual point list.
输入一条曲线:二次曲线、正弦+噪声或随机游走。: Input a curve: quadratic, sine+noise, or random walk.
数值矩阵热力图:取表格前 10 个数值列,行数自动降采样以保证流畅。可接入\"色: Heatmap of numeric matrix: first 10 numeric columns, row auto-downsampled for smoothness. Optionally wired to Color Bands for custom gradient, or edited directly in the panel.
选取表格中两(三)列生成散点,并携带点形状/大小/颜色。点大小与点颜色可暴露为输: Pick 2(3) columns from a table to produce scatter with shape/size/color. Size/color exposed as inputs — each point's size/color proportional to its row value.
选取表格中两列生成曲线,并携带线形状/粗细/颜色。线宽与线颜色可暴露为输入口,接: Pick 2 columns from a table to produce a curve with shape/width/color. Width/color exposed as inputs — vary per segment from data columns.
以表格两列绘制散点图;也可直接接入散点/曲线数据可视化。: Plot scatter from two table columns; or wire scatter/curve data directly.
以表格两列绘制柱状图(分类 + 数值)。: Bar chart from two table columns (category + value).
以表格一列(或多条曲线)绘制折线图。: Line chart from one table column (or multiple curves).
原理化模式:接收点/线/面(均可多路连接)、分布、文本与坐标系,所有图元缩放至互: Procedural mode: consumes point/line/surface (multi-input), distributions, text, and coordinate system. All primitives scaled into the orthogonal axis box; preview matches coordinate system size.
逐个添加数据点:每个点可独立设置 X/Y 坐标、大小、形状与颜色。初始只有一个加: Add data points one by one: each with its own X/Y, size, shape, color. Starts with a plus button, keep adding.
点击节点查看输出数据预览: Click a node to view output data preview
此节点为可视化节点,查看节点内图表: This is a viewer node - see the chart inside
检测到连接回路,部分节点未按顺序执行: Circular connection detected - some nodes may not run in order
图元或连线变更后自动重新执行整个数据流: Auto-run the entire data flow when nodes or edges change
界面亮暗模式,切换后立即生效并持久化保存: Light or dark mode - applied immediately and saved
修改自动保存至 settings.json: Changes are saved automatically to settings.json
界面显示语言: UI language. Add new languages by placing <locale>.json in assets/language/
